findings.summary: BuildPostPrReviewBatchPromptInput and buildPostPrReviewBatchPrompt omit previousBuildError and previousCodeVerifyReason, preventing the agent from receiving feedback on failed batch retries.
findings.suggested_fix: Add previousBuildError and previousCodeVerifyReason to BuildPostPrReviewBatchPromptInput and render them in buildPostPrReviewBatchPrompt just like buildPostPrReviewTaskPrompt does.
